sovereign_country.strategic_role: 支持全中文章程、传统华人客群离岸家族信托常驻地

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Offshore Trade Intermediary and Commercial Re-Invoicing Operations

applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: No standalone bilateral investment treaty currently in force with any major counterparty; protection for re-invoicing intermediaries is derived principally from domestic legislation and general international trade disciplines.
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER-Plus) applies to goods, services and investment-related disciplines among Pacific Forum members.
Tax Information Exchange Agreements with Australia, New Zealand and the United States are in force and govern fiscal transparency, not investment protection or double tax relief.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: International Companies Act 1987 (Act No. 18 of 1987, as amended by the International Companies Amendment Act 2007 and the International Companies Amendment Act 2016), Companies Act 2001 (Act No. 12 of 2001), Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2018 (Act No. 30 of 2018), and the International Companies (Registration and Agents) Regulations 2014. Beneficial ownership records are mandated by section 91 of the International Companies Act 1987, requiring licensed registered agents to collect, verify and retain UBO data for inspection by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit and the Registrar of International Companies.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified true copy of the passport of each ultimate beneficial owner and director
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport authority or notary public in the country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of residential address of each beneficial owner and director (utility bill or bank statement dated within 90 days)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Utility company or licensed deposit-taking institution

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Bank reference letter confirming the applicant's good standing and the source of funds to be introduced
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Licensed commercial bank in the applicant's jurisdiction

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Professional reference letter from an attorney-at-law, chartered accountant, or licensed trust company
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Law firm, accounting firm, or licensed corporate services provider

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: For corporate UBOs, certified copies of certificate of incorporation, memorandum and articles, register of directors, and certificate of incumbency or equivalent evidence of ownership chain
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Registry of companies in the corporate UBO's jurisdiction and its licensed registered agent or corporate secretary

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Source of wealth and source of funds declaration for any PEP or high-risk beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Independently prepared sworn statement executed before a notary public

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All proposed directors, shareholders, ultimate beneficial owners, signatories, and material counterparties must be screened against the United Nations Consolidated Security Council Sanctions List, OFAC SDN and Non-SDN Lists, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HM Treasury Sanctions List, and the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit domestic watchlist. Due diligence must be completed before submission of the incorporation application. Enhanced due diligence is mandatory for politically exposed persons and their family members or close associates, requiring verified source of wealth, ongoing transaction monitoring, and written approval from the compliance officer of the licensed agent before the relationship is established.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Registrar of International Companies within the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Samoa; name search and reservation are submitted through a licensed international company registered agent using the Samoa Companies Registry online search facility and the associated approved form (IC-1) for international companies.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory name of an international company must be expressed in English or in Roman script; it must end with 'Limited' or the abbreviation 'Ltd.' as required by section 9 of the International Companies Act 1987. A name in a non-Roman script, including Chinese characters, may be adopted only as an additional secondary name, and a certified Roman-script transliteration and an English translation must be filed with the Registrar. The company's registered statutory name shall be the Roman-script version; the secondary non-Roman name has no separate legal effect without an approved English transliteration.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: In the event of a name rejection, the proposed incorporator may instruct its licensed registered agent to file a written notice of appeal with the Registrar of International Companies within 14 days of the date of rejection. The appeal must identify the statutory ground relied upon, supply the proposed corrected name, and explain why the name is not objectionable. The Registrar must determine the appeal within 14 days. A further appeal lies to the Supreme Court of Samoa by way of an originating application for judicial review filed within 30 days of the Registrar's final decision. If the appeal is unsuccessful, a fresh name reservation may be submitted immediately with a different name; the same name cannot be re-submitted for a period of six months from the date of the original refusal unless the basis of the refusal has been cured.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A virtual office is not sufficient to satisfy the statutory registered office requirement. Every International Company must maintain a physical registered office in Samoa and a licensed registered agent with a verified street address; the registered office may be the premises of the licensed agent. The company's substantive operations, including re-invoicing and trade intermediary activities, may be directed remotely from outside Samoa, but the registered office must remain accessible to the Registrar and the Financial Intelligence Unit for the service of legal process and for inspection of statutory records.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low for offshore re-invoicing intermediaries, approximately 2% to 5% annual probability of inspection or documentary audit of the licensed agent's records in relation to such companies. Unannounced physical inspections may be carried out by the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit under the AML/CFT Act 2018 where there is a reasonable suspicion of money laundering or terrorism financing; these inspections will ordinarily take place at the registered agent's physical premises rather than at the client's offshore business location.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government fee for name search and reservation of an International Company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Samoa
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory fee schedule under the International Companies Act 1987 and associated regulations

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Government certificate of incorporation and registration of International Company
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour, Samoa
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff for incorporation under the International Companies Act 1987

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent and physical registered office service fee for the first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Licensed international company registered agent in Samoa
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for licensed registered agent services in Samoa

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: AML/CFT customer due diligence and UBO verification bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Compliance department of the licensed registered agent or retained counsel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market rate for KYC, PEP, sanctions screening, and UBO source-of-funds verification

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and apostille or consular legalization fees per document bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public, relevant competent authority under the Hague Apostille Convention, or consular post in the document's country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official tariff for notarial acts and apostille or consular legalization service in the country of origin

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Preparation of constitutional documents, UBO declarations, and compliance file in English
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Retained international tax counsel or licensed corporate services provider
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for offshore corporate legal drafting and UBO compliance documentation

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (Samoa), as amended; key ss. 5 (constitution), 9 (name restrictions), 13-16 (memorandum, articles, certificate of incorporation), 18-20 (registered office and registered agent), 74-82 (directors, secretary, officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Apia, Samoa, acting exclusively through MCIL-licensed registered agents
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation (Form 1) submitted with the signed Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association per ss. 13-16 of the International Companies Act 1987
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital; a Schedule 4 category A1 International Trading Company may commence business with zero issued capital, and no escrow or capital contribution undertaking is required
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED THAT the subscribers' allotment of 1,000 ordinary shares of US$1.00 each be ratified and recorded in the register of members, consideration being satisfied by the subscription undertaking in the memorandum. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT the registered office at the office of the Company's registered agent in Apia, Samoa, be adopted as the registered office under the International Companies Act 1987. RESOLVED FURTHER THAT [Name] be appointed director and [Name] be appointed secretary, each to hold office until successors are appointed, and the officers be authorized to execute incidental filings, open bank accounts, and engage the registered agent.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIL Companies Registry, Apia (mandatory filing channel: licensed Samoan registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Instruct the licensed registered agent to search the Companies Registry index for identical or confusingly similar names and file a name reservation; ensure the proposed name carries a mandatory corporate suffix ('Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation' or 'Inc.'), avoids words restricted by s.9 such as 'Bank', 'Assurance', 'Trust' or 'Insurance', and is acceptable for the A1 offshore trading scope.
required_dossiers: Name reservation application signed by the intended incorporator
Confirmation that the proposed company is of category A1 (International Trading Company)
Written consent of the registered agent to act
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the reserved name is refused for similarity or restricted wording, submit a revised name within 5 business days without an additional registration fee, or file a written request for administrative reconsideration by the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Execution of Memorandum and Articles
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed registered agent and notary public; subscriber signatures may be executed overseas with notarization or apostille
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Prepare the memorandum (name, registered office clause, share capital clause, subscriber details) and the articles (allotment, director powers, officer indemnity, quorum). Execute in counterpart, expressly recording the Schedule 4 A1 purposes of general re-invoicing and trade intermediation, and affix the notarial certificate or apostille where execution occurs outside Samoa.
required_dossiers: Memorandum of Association
Articles of Association
Subscriber consent forms and specimen signatures
Identity documents of each director and shareholder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar rejects the instruments on legal deficiency, amend and re-execute the relevant document and file a substitute within 14 days of the written notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent lodges Form 1 with the executed memorandum and articles, statements of the registered office and agent, particulars of the first director and secretary, and the statutory declaration of the registered agent confirming compliance with the International Companies Act 1987; the USD 200 government incorporation fee is paid at lodgment.
required_dossiers: Form 1 (Application for Incorporation)
Executed Memorandum and Articles of Association
Consent of the registered agent
Statutory declaration of the registered agent
Copy of the name reservation approval
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried, the registered agent cures deficiencies by filing amended schedules within the period stated in the query notice; failure to cure results in a refund of the fee less administrative costs and a fresh application.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, MCIL, Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfaction that all statutory requirements are met, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing a registration number and date; the company comes into existence on the certificate date, and the registered agent obtains certified copies for the corporate record book.
required_dossiers: Original Certificate of Incorporation
Registered number confirmation
Certified copy of the memorandum and articles stamped by the Registrar
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is not issued within the statutory timeframe, the registered agent follows up in writing; any refusal is appealable to the Supreme Court of Samoa by judicial review within 21 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Governance and Annual Compliance Filing
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MCIL and the licensed registered agent; AML supervisor for beneficial ownership records
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold the first board meeting (written resolution permitted), issue share certificates, open registers of members, directors and charges, and complete the beneficial ownership information file maintained by the registered agent under Samoan AML/CFT obligations; concurrently open a foreign-currency account with a licensed international bank and calendar the annual government fee payment.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
First Board Resolution (executed minutes)
Register of members and share certificates
Register of directors and secretary
Beneficial ownership information file
Bank account opening package (certificate, memorandum and articles)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Late filing of annual documents attracts late penalties under the MCIL fee schedule; remedy by prompt filing and payment, after which the company is restored to good standing.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Trade and Commerce Division, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) — Business Licence Unit (applicable only to onshore activities under the Business Licences Act 1998)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Exempt — the A1 International Trading Company authorization conferred by the Certificate of Incorporation under the International Companies Act 1987 constitutes the operational authorization for offshore trade intermediation and re-invoicing; no separate industrial licence attaches to the offshore business

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE) — Environment Assessment Unit (Planning and Urban Management Act 2004)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — pure re-invoicing and trade intermediation without any physical plant in Samoa falls outside the PUMA 2004 list of permitted activities requiring screening or a full EIA report; a category assessment is triggered only if the entity later establishes a local office, warehouse or processing facility
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Not applicable to offshore paper operations; if a Samoan physical premises is later established, the premises must comply with MNRE wastewater and solid waste standards, the Hazardous Waste Management Regulations, and applicable air quality limits for any stationary combustion equipment

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire and Emergency Services Authority Act 2007 — a Certificate of Fitness to Occupy is required for any occupied Samoan premises; the registered agent's office already holds this certification. No employees are engaged in Samoa, so no occupational safety registration or Samoa National Provident Fund enrolment is triggered; if local staff are hired later, Accident Compensation Corporation and SNPF registrations become mandatory.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA); official portal: https://sra.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities incorporate an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act 1987 via the Samoa Registrar of Companies (MCIL) and obtain a Certificate of Incorporation. A wholly tax-exempt IC is not registered for income tax purposes and does not obtain a TIN from SRA solely for offshore activity. If the IC enters the domestic tax net (e.g. local payroll, lease, or importation), the registered agent must submit the SRA TIN application and VAGST registration form through the SRA online services portal, attaching certified constitutional documents, identity documents of directors, and the registered-office certificate. The statutory registration threshold for VAGST is WS$100,000 of taxable supplies; below this threshold, registration is voluntary but requires SRA approval.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: Samoa does not operate a U.S.-style check-the-box or equivalent deemed-entity election. The International Companies Act 1987 provides the sole classification election: registration as an International Company automatically confers statutory tax-exempt status, with no ability to 'check out' of the exemption. The Act also permits election to become a protected cell company (PCC) or a company limited by guarantee, but these forms do not alter the tax-exempt characterization. Hybrid mismatch elections are not available to Samoa ICs; Samoa's Income Tax Act contains CFC and potentially anti-hybrid rules that apply independently of entity status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST) – VAT on supplies and imports
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WS$100,000 annual taxable supplies in Samoa Tala
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance or digital stamping mandate is in force for domestic VAGST invoices. VAGST-registered businesses must issue serially numbered tax invoices and retain records for SRA inspection. Import and export declarations are processed through ASYCUDA World customs automation; no separate SRA e-invoicing API is required.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A VAGST-registered person may zero-rate (i) goods physically exported from Samoa and evidenced by customs export entry; (ii) services supplied to a non-resident and consumed wholly outside Samoa; (iii) international transport and related services; and (iv) supplies to prescribed offshore enterprises. An International Company engaged solely in offshore re-invoicing typically does not make a supply in Samoa and therefore falls outside the VAGST net; zero-rating may be claimed only if the entity is registered for VAGST and the supplies clear Samoan customs.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World electronic printout)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill consigned to the offshore buyer
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT payment advice proving settlement
Original commercial invoice and packing list
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The SRA cross-matches ASYCUDA export declarations with VAGST returns and banking records. False or unsupported zero-rating claims result in an immediate return to 15% VAGST liability, clawback of any refund, interest, a late payment penalty at 2% per month, a civil shortfall penalty up to 100% of tax, and criminal prosecution for knowingly presenting false documents (fine of up to WS$100,000 and/or imprisonment). Exchange-control penalties and deregistration of the International Company also apply.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa), operating under the Central Bank Act 2001 and the Exchange Control Regulations 1978
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoa tala (WST) is not freely convertible. Current account payments for bona fide trade transactions are permissible through licensed authorized dealers subject to supporting documentation. Capital account transfers, including equity injections, intercompany loan advances, and non-resident profit remittances, require prior exchange control approval or must be effected through a CBS-licensed commercial bank under delegated authority. Profit remittance hurdles include proof of source of funds, tax clearance certification, corporate KYC documentation, and compliance with Samoa's withholding tax and annual filing obligations.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Samoa exchange control regulations require exporters to surrender export proceeds to an authorized dealer within a statutory timeline, normally not exceeding 90 days from shipment or receipt, unless a specific exemption is granted by the Central Bank of Samoa. Mandatory conversion into WST applies to export receipts unless the exporter is approved to retain designated foreign currency balances for operational trade settlement. All export transactions must be documented on the prescribed CBS exchange control declaration or customs export form, and the physical trade and invoice trail must be retained for verification.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account and Operational Account
Operational Account and Trade Finance Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low-to-Medium. Offshore digital EMIs are not viable as the primary or sole banking channel for a Samoa International Company because Samoa exchange control, the CBS supervisory framework, and WST settlement requirements mandate the use of a domestic authorized dealer for regulated financial services. An offshore EMI may be considered only as a secondary treasury concentration vehicle for non-WST receivables, provided that the entity submits to a robust independent AML review, maintains transaction transparency, and keeps the primary clearing corridor through a CBS-licensed bank.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Directors, authorized signatories, and beneficial owners are normally required to participate in a physical KYC interview with the onboarding bank in Samoa, or at an accredited overseas branch or embassy-aligned notary arrangement where the bank's AML policy permits. Remote-only account opening is generally disfavored and is rarely accepted absent a strong existing banking relationship, verified foreign bank reference, and enhanced due diligence on the corporate structure and beneficial owners.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore company structure with non-resident ownership and re-invoicing trade flows
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Independent legal opinion on the Samoa International Company formation, current certificate of incorporation and certificate of good standing, board resolutions establishing the re-invoicing trade hub, economic substance or tax transparency memorandum, full beneficial ownership register, corporate organizational chart, and a narrative flow-of-funds document describing each reinvoicing leg and its commercial purpose.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-velocity invoice transactions between related or affiliated trading parties
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Master trade agreements, individual purchase orders, supplier invoices, customer invoices, shipping and logistics documents such as bills of lading and customs certificates, inspections and quality certificates, insurance certificates, detailed transaction-level audit trail, and an explanation of the commercial mark-up and operating expenses supporting the reinvoicing margin.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Sanctions and jurisdiction risk flags on counterparties or payment channels
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Sanctions screening reports for all counterparties and ultimate beneficial owners, denial and debarment list checks, adverse media review, proof of source of wealth, negative PEP declarations, bank reference letters, and evidence of compliance with Samoa's AML/CFT statutory obligations.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound capital contributions must be routed through a CBS-licensed authorized dealer bank in Samoa using SWIFT MT103 cash transfers or, where appropriate, MT202 cover payments. The SWIFT field 70 narrative should clearly state 'Share Capital Contribution' or 'Increase in Paid-Up Capital' and reference the relevant corporate resolution. Prior exchange control approval must be obtained where the amount exceeds prescribed thresholds or where the capital transfer is treated as a non-resident inward direct investment. The onboarding bank must receive the corporate KYC pack, source-of-funds certification, bank statements of the remitting entity, notarized board resolution, and confirmation of the capital account entry in the Samoa International Company's statutory ledger.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements for suppliers and trade creditors should be executed via SWIFT MT103 wire transfers through the Samoa bank's correspondent banking network. For larger and more structured trade settlements, confirmed irrevocable commercial letters of credit opened by the Samoa bank are preferred, supported by transport documents, commercial invoices, and insurance certificates. The reinvoicing hub may also use XT/third-party electronic transfer rails for isolated non-WST payments, provided the transaction is documented under the internal treasury policy and subject to CBS resident-account and AML screening.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore spot foreign exchange trades executed with CBS-licensed authorized dealers for WST/USD and major trade currencies
Physical-settlement forward contracts on WST/USD or USD/EUR entered into with a CBS-licensed bank for approved underlying trade exposure
Cross-currency swaps approved by the Central Bank of Samoa and entered into for the management of long-term foreign-currency liabilities

Offshore non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) may be used only as a secondary risk-management overlay with internal treasury approval and clear documentation of the inability to obtain an onshore hedge; NDFs are not generally available or permissible as the primary hedging instrument in Samoa

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Renewal Return and Prescribed Annual Fee Payment (Samoa International Company)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA) / Registrar of International Companies, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 30 days after the annual anniversary of incorporation; the renewal is processed through the licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late penalty of 50% of the annual fee after 30 days; continued default for 90 days or more may trigger administrative strike-off proceedings, followed by dissolution and loss of legal personality.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit for a general international company, regardless of turnover; audit is mandatory only for licensed international banks, insurance companies, and trustee companies under the respective licensing regimes.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: IFRS as adopted in Samoa; voluntary statutory audit, where prepared, must follow IFRS; the International Company is otherwise required only to maintain books and records sufficient to explain its transactions and financial position.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: A beneficial ownership register is maintained and updated within 14 days of any shareholding change; the annual renewal pack requires confirmation from the registered agent of all current members, ultimate beneficial owners, and any transfers made during the year. Share transfers must be approved by the directors and entered in the Register of Members before the annual confirmation is submitted.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required; US$2,500–US$5,000 per annum if voluntarily commissioned

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 27% resident company rate under the Income Tax Act 2012; effective headline rate of 0% for an International Company (IC) on foreign-source offshore income by statutory exemption.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective rate on qualifying offshore income under Section 204 of the International Companies Act 1987; exemption from dividends withholding tax on IC distributions; no capital gains tax; no stamp duty on offshore instruments; no exchange control restrictions.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return and Annual Fee Declaration — submitted to the Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL), Companies Online Registry (COR); administered through a licensed registered agent.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within 30 days of the anniversary of incorporation each year; annual fee payable to MCIL on the same date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, IC registration number, and date of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identifies the IC in the MCIL registry; an SIRD tax reference number is not required for offshore-only entities.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Samoa and particulars of the licensed registered agent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The physical Samoa address is maintained by the registered agent; correspondence may be served c/o the agent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital; computation of the annual government fee by capital band.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders do not trigger additional Samoan tax; fee bands are published by MCIL.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Directors and beneficial owners schedule; confirmation of the beneficial ownership register location.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The BO register must be held at the registered office in Samoa and produced to the Registrar on lawful demand.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of offshore status; confirmation that no business is being carried on in Samoa.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If any Samoa-source domestic business is conducted, the IC must cease the activity, obtain a local business licence, and register for corporate income tax and VAGST.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Director or registered agent signature and certification of accuracy.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A knowingly false declaration is a criminal offence and exposes the signatory to personal liability.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing surcharge of WST 1,000 per month or part thereof; failure to file for six months or more may result in automatic strike-off, deregistration, and freezing action over the IC's Samoa assets.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Samoa Company Income Tax Return (IRD CT-1) — filed via the Samoa Inland Revenue Department (SIRD) eFiling portal; required only if the IC derives Samoa-source taxable income, which is not expected for an exempt offshore re-invoicing hub.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 6 months after the end of the tax year, which is the calendar year; for a 31 December year-end, the return is due by 30 June.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross income; residents report worldwide income, non-residents report Samoa-source income only.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For the IC, list total invoiced sales but identify Samoa-source sales separately; offshore re-invoicing margin is excluded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Income exempt under Section 204 of the International Companies Act 1987.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Offshore re-invoicing commissions and trade margins; substantiate with contracts, shipping documents, and counterparty tax residency.
Where no Samoa-source income exists, report nil; the IC remains outside the IRD filing net.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Allowable deductions directly attributable to assessable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only expenses incurred in producing Samoa-source income are deductible; head office and related-party recharges must satisfy the arm's length principle.
Nil for an exempt IC with no domestic trade.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Corporate income tax at 27%, with credit for foreign withholding tax under an applicable double tax agreement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Treaty credits are allowed only upon submission of a valid Certificate of Tax Residence issued by SIRD.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net tax payable or refund due.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payment must be made through SIRD eFiling by the statutory deadline; instalment rules apply once the IC is in the domestic net.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing penalty of the greater of WST 500 or 5% of tax payable; late payment surcharge of 2.5% per month or part thereof, capped at 50%; default interest at the statutory rate; wilful non-filing may result in criminal prosecution and deregistration.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 15% statutory dividend withholding tax applies to non-resident shareholders under the Income Tax Act 2012; the effective rate is 0% on dividends declared by an exempt International Company out of foreign-source reserves, provided the IC does not carry on business in Samoa.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: To invoke treaty relief, the beneficial owner must submit to SIRD the prescribed TRC application; SIRD issues a Certificate of Tax Residence, which is forwarded to the paying entity in the source state together with a completed treaty relief declaration. Under the Samoa-China DTA the dividend rate may be reduced to 5% for a 10% or greater shareholding, otherwise 15%; under the Samoa-Australia and Samoa-New Zealand DTAs comparable reduction is available. SIRD processing typically takes 10 to 15 business days; no stamp duty applies to the application.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory non-resident withholding rates: interest 15%, royalties 15%, management fees 15%; treaty-reduced rates under the Samoa-China DTA, Samoa-Australia DTA, and Samoa-New Zealand DTA are generally 10% for interest and 10% for royalties; the IC must not gross up the withholding unless contractually required.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No express monetary threshold is published in the Income Tax Act 2012; the arm's length principle applies to all controlled transactions. The practical administrative documentation threshold for related-party re-invoicing flows is WST 1,000,000 per annum; contemporaneous benchmarking, transfer pricing policy documentation, and records must be maintained in English for 7 years.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable. The International Companies (Economic Substance) Regulations 2019 impose a substance test on ICs conducting 'relevant activities'; a re-invoicing hub falls under 'distribution and service centre' where revenue is derived from goods or services supplied to or purchased from group companies. The IC must show: (1) core income-generating activities are directed and managed in Samoa; (2) adequate physical premises are maintained in Samoa; (3) adequate full-time or equivalent employees are engaged in Samoa; and (4) adequate operating expenditure is incurred in Samoa. An annual economic substance declaration must be filed with MCIL; failure attracts a penalty of up to WST 30,000, additional daily surcharges for continuing default, and automatic exchange of information notification to the beneficial owner's home tax authority.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion / Abuse of IC Exemption
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Conducting actual commercial trade with Samoa residents or deriving Samoa-source income while continuing to book all margin as exempt offshore re-invoicing profit, without an IC business licence or CIT/VAGST registration.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment of undeclared profits at 27% CIT; default interest of 1% per month; civil penalty of up to 200% of tax evaded; deregistration and strike-off under the International Companies Act 1987.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors may be personally assessed for taxes where the entity is operated as a sham or cloak; criminal conviction on indictment attracts a fine of up to WST 100,000 and imprisonment for up to 2 years; the court may impose travel bans and asset freezing orders.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Shell Company / Failure of Economic Substance
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating a pure booking shell for re-invoicing with no physical office, no employees, no Samoa management decisions, and no Samoa-based record keeping; the IC fails the 'distribution and service centre' substance test.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Penalty up to WST 30,000 plus daily surcharges for continued non-compliance; mandatory exchange of information to the ultimate parent jurisdiction; deregistration by the Registrar of International Companies.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face disqualification from acting as directors of any Samoa entity for up to 5 years; personal fines for knowingly filing a false substance declaration; information exchange may trigger foreign prosecution for tax evasion in the home jurisdiction.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Setting re-invoicing margins outside arm's length range, booking artificially thin or negative margins, or failing to prepare and retain contemporaneous transfer pricing documentation for intercompany transactions above the WST 1,000,000 threshold.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: SIRD may adjust taxable income to arm's length levels; penalty of up to 50% of the tax avoided; late payment interest applied from the original due date; possible suspension of the taxpayer's right to object to the assessment.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign or approve false transfer pricing accounts are jointly and severally liable for the adjusted tax and penalties; fraudulent intent may lead to criminal prosecution with imprisonment of up to 7 years.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / CFT Violations and Beneficial Ownership Defaults
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the IC as an unregistered payment intermediary for sanctioned parties, failing to conduct AML/KYC on counterparties, or omitting beneficial ownership information from the Samoa BO register to conceal the principal behind the re-invoicing profit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Corporate fines up to WST 1,000,000 under the Samoa AML/CFT Act 2018; licence revocation and strike-off; freezing of assets under regulatory orders; inclusion of the entity on an international sanctions or high-risk notification list.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Individuals convicted of money laundering face imprisonment of up to 14 years; directors may be subject to personal fines, travel bans, and confiscation orders; breach of the beneficial ownership filing duty triggers personal liability for continuing daily penalties.
